Class WebScroll

java.lang.Object
com.shaft.gui.element.internal.WebScroll
public final class WebScroll extends Object
Synchronous scroll-into-view for web drivers.

One check serves scrollingMode w3c, javascript, and legacy, locate-time scroll, and the non-Appium touch scroll. The scroll assigns scrollLeft and scrollTop on the nested overflow ancestor (or the document) and returns only after that assignment. It does not use behavior: "smooth". Unchanged scrollLeft and scrollTop are not movement. A target that is still outside the viewport is not treated as scrolled into view. The document scrolling element is measured against the layout viewport (0, 0, innerWidth, innerHeight). A nested overflow ancestor keeps its own border box.
